title: Two architectural paintings
slide_intent: Allow different spatial arrangements within one visual grammar because consistency can come from relationships rather than identical placement.
strategic_value: Whitney can accommodate paintings with different compositions while retaining a thin angular signature.
demonstration: Two portrait layouts place architectural paintings below differently shaped W marks.
practical_value: Compare a symmetric upper W with an asymmetric version before deciding how a mark should occupy residual space.

content_islands.name: Left composition
content_islands.spec: Place the architectural painting under a balanced W.

content_islands.name: Right composition
content_islands.spec: Place the house painting below a diagonal, uneven W whose final stroke rises toward the right edge.

reference_purposes.Expression: The paired preliminary sketches retain the same thin-line mark while changing its shape.
reference_purposes.Application: Each painting is paired with an identity shape adapted to its available space.
